case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to support our operations with reliable delivery and an extensive inventory. This is why we are writing with a proposal that gives your plant steady, binding load: we would move our fastener kit to Leitner & Sohn as one bundle, business on top of what you supply us today, and Option A secures it for both family companies.

On the price history:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On the nut as well:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the binding volume and the longer contract term, and it is a fair solution for both of us.

In plain words, Option A gives Leitner & Sohn a binding annual volume over a long contract term, additional to current business, for steady use of your plant. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Thank you for taking it forward. We look forward to your answer.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Although the historical prices for the individual bolts and nuts have remained unchanged, providing these as a consolidated kit requires additional processing. We welcome the opportunity to secure a 24-month contract and the binding annual volume of 30,000 units.

Our main current offer stands at a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we are willing to agree to the 90-day payment terms and 24-month duration of Option A, provided the unit price is adjusted to €5.58, giving a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Our options give you exactly that: steady, binding load for your plant, on top of what you supply us today.

Thank you for confirming that the price history holds. We take your point on the kit, and since the individual parts have not moved, here is one more part where the price has stayed flat:
Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70610@2026Q3).

Option A is the package we can approve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.24; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you may need to take this further internally, here is a short paragraph for your decision-maker. It gives a fair price for both family companies and a long-term basis for working together.

Could you please take Option A to the person who decides? We would be glad to settle this with you in a spirit of fair partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We note your data regarding the washers and our delivery performance; however, the additional processing required for the consolidated kit remains a factor in our calculation. Furthermore, our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. 

We have discussed your proposal internally as requested, and to support our long-term partnership, we are prepared to make a further concession. Our current proposal is a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Building on your Option A, we can accept the 45-day payment terms and the 24-month contract duration, and we offer a revised price of €5.48 per unit. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 5 days. With overtime we can deliver in 5 days, at a premium.
